summary.zh: Aedas、深圳市华阳国际与 MLA+B.V. 联合设计的建筑产业园区，以智能、生态与近零碳为目标，将总部办公、研发、宿舍、食堂与展示空间组织进绿意环抱的园区。项目于 2023 年底中标后进入深化与实施阶段。

Headquarters offices, R&D, residences, dining, and exhibition spaces are gathered into a landscape-rich setting that entered detailed development after its late-2023 competition win.

summary.zh: 项目位于广州南沙明珠湾横沥岛尖，以“岭南指韵，山水长卷”为意向，将东方山水美学转译为起伏有致的滨水城市空间。建筑群回应金融岛天际线，并以现代岭南场域连接城市活力与自然气息。
summary.en: Located at the tip of Hengli Island in Guangzhou’s Nansha Pearl Bay, the project translates an Eastern landscape composition into a layered waterfront district. Its skyline and public realm bring the energy of a financial island together with a contemporary Lingnan sense of place.

summary.en: The 2021NJY-12 plot on Hengli Island combines commercial, workplace, and residential uses in a landscape-led complex. Conceived as an island gateway and waterfront oasis, it brings Lingnan urban life into an outward-looking benchmark for Pearl Bay.

summary.en: A service district for the International Collaborative Innovation Zone, bringing together talent housing, a cultural and sports centre, and an energy control centre. The 30,171-square-metre site is structured as a vertical neighbourhood that supports daily life, exchange, recreation, and public services for young innovation workers.

summary.zh: 设计保留原有街巷尺度、空间关系与重要节点，通过“镶嵌”式新建介入形成新旧对话。文化通廊连接英东大道、环市大道与公祠、天后古庙，并以玻璃、金属、清水混凝土结合青砖、瓦片与蚝壳墙，形成面向未来的“新岭南”语汇。
summary.en: The design preserves the scale, relationships, and key nodes of the existing lanes while introducing new buildings as tectonic insertions. Cultural corridors connect the main roads to ancestral landmarks, and contemporary materials are paired with blue brick, tiles, and oyster-shell walls to form a forward-looking New Lingnan language.

role.zh: 专业建筑项目 · 个人职责待补充

summary.zh: 项目以“漂浮在水岸的文体方舟”为意象，通过“三重水韵”组织自然与人文。液态流线构成蓝色水系与绿色廊道，波浪形金属幕墙模拟水波光影；主要建筑以架空方式保留原生植被，形成建筑生长于自然的场所体验。
summary.en: Conceived as a cultural and sports ark floating beside the water, the complex uses a three-part aquatic narrative to connect nature and community. Flowing blue and green networks meet wave-like metal façades, while raised building volumes preserve existing vegetation and appear to grow from the landscape.

zh.atlasTitle: 作品不是卡片，是三个空间入口。
zh.atlasIntro: 每个入口先提出一个空间问题，再进入图纸、模型、玩法和迭代过程。
zh.methodTitle: 同一种空间思维，两种设计尺度。
zh.methodText: 建筑训练负责组织尺度、光线与动线；关卡设计把这些关系变成节奏、风险与选择。最终呈现的不只是效果图，而是空间决策如何影响体验。

en.heroIntro: Translating scale, circulation, sightlines, and sense of place into experiences players can read, choose, and remember.

en.atlasTitle: Not a grid of cards, but three spatial entrances.
en.atlasIntro: Each entrance begins with a spatial question, then opens into drawings, models, play, and iteration.
en.methodTitle: One spatial mindset, two scales of design.
en.methodText: Architecture organizes scale, light, and circulation. Level design turns those relationships into pacing, risk, and choice. The work shows not only final images, but how spatial decisions change experience.

description.en: A level designer with an architectural background, focused on spatial experience, player routes, and pacing across exploration, puzzle, and narrative-driven games.

summary.zh: 建筑学背景转关卡策划，具备箱庭/区域关卡的空间组织、平面推演与场景白盒搭建能力。参与多项 Game Jam 项目的核心玩法构建、关卡流程设计与白盒验证，关注探索、解谜、叙事驱动与生活模拟类游戏中的空间体验、POI 布置、探索动线与玩家节奏设计。能够从玩法目标拆解到关卡流程、空间布局与交互节点设计，并与程序、美术协作推进内容落地。熟悉使用 Codex 辅助编程解决 UE5 工程难题，利用 ComfyUI 控制生成游戏美术资产。
summary.en: With an architectural background and a focus on level design, I work across spatial organization, plan-based reasoning, and scene blockouts for sandbox and area-based levels. I have contributed to the core gameplay, level flow, and blockout validation of several Game Jam projects, with a focus on exploration, puzzles, narrative-driven play, life simulation, POI placement, traversal, and player pacing. I move from gameplay goals to level flows, spatial layouts, and interaction nodes, then work with programmers and artists to bring the design into production. I also use Codex to solve UE5 engineering problems and ComfyUI to control the generation of game art assets.

company.zh: 凯达环球建筑设计咨询有限公司 Aedas（深圳）

bullets.zh: 参与概念方案推演与空间结构验证，能够快速从平面关系推导三维空间布局。
bullets.en: Contributed to concept development and spatial-structure validation, quickly translating plan relationships into three-dimensional layouts.

bullets.zh: 调研用户类型，通过白盒设计优化空间构造，服务于客户心流体验；基于平剖面推演，使用 Grasshopper 与 Rhino 完成参数化建模及后期渲染表达，准确传达空间细节与设计巧思。
bullets.en: Researched user types and used blockout design to refine spatial structures for client flow; developed parametric models and rendered design studies with Grasshopper and Rhino to communicate spatial detail and intent.

bullets.zh: 作为 AI 研究员，将 Stable Diffusion 工作流融入工作，提高前期意向表达图产出效率 80%+，在保持图面质量的同时快速传达模型细节，加快跨部门沟通协作。
bullets.en: As an AI researcher, integrated Stable Diffusion workflows into early-stage design, improving the output efficiency of intent images by 80%+ while communicating model detail faster across teams.

bullets.zh: 构建建造规范 Agent 智能体，利用 RAG 技术融合业务所在城市的建筑设计规范文本，辅助项目落地设计师检索当地设计规章制度。
bullets.en: Built a construction-regulation Agent using RAG to combine local architectural code text and support designers in retrieving relevant regulations during project delivery.

company.zh: 深圳市建筑设计研究总院（院士创作室）

bullets.zh: 在多版本方案迭代中培养了围绕目标行为组织动线、节点与体验节奏的能力；在一周内创作出 10 余种比选方案，供团队讨论选择最终深化方案。
bullets.en: Developed the ability to organize circulation, nodes, and experiential rhythm around target behaviors through multi-version iteration; produced more than ten options in one week for the team to compare and select for further development.

bullets.zh: 熟悉 Rhino、Grasshopper 等工具，可高效完成空间结构表达与方案验证。
bullets.en: Used Rhino, Grasshopper, and related tools to efficiently express spatial structures and validate design options.

bullets.zh: 围绕角色机制与剧情目标，梳理角色与场景的交互规则，搭建关卡核心体验框架。
bullets.en: Mapped character-scene interaction rules around character mechanics and narrative goals to establish the core level-experience framework.

bullets.zh: 调研相关类型游戏，确认剧情大纲与关卡结合的叙事逻辑，根据角色机制设计角色与世界的交互规则。
bullets.en: Researched related genres, defined the narrative logic connecting the story outline and level, and designed character-world interactions around the character mechanics.

bullets.zh: 设计关卡流程与空间布局，将探索、解谜与叙事节点整合到统一的关卡推进中；基于关卡流程进行平面布局推导与空间白盒搭建，关注区域结构、兴趣点布置与探索路径设计。
bullets.en: Designed level flow and spatial layout, combining exploration, puzzles, and narrative beats in one progression; derived plans and built spatial blockouts from the flow, with attention to area structure, POI placement, and traversal routes.

bullets.zh: 搭建关卡白盒，组织玩家在有限信息环境下完成探索、判断与风险规避。
bullets.en: Built the level blockout to organize exploration, judgment, and risk avoidance under limited information.

bullets.en: Built a ComfyUI workflow that generates player avatars in real time from the MBTI personality type implied by player choices, using SDXL, IP-Adapter, RMBG, and related techniques.

bullets.zh: 利用 Figma 及 Axure 设计游戏 UI，制定玩家 UI 交互方式，通过试玩反馈持续改进界面体验。
bullets.en: Designed the game UI in Figma and Axure, defined player interaction patterns, and iterated on the interface through playtest feedback.

bullets.zh: 编写设计需求文档，将 ComfyUI 工作流逻辑及 MBTI 计算方式对接程序，并与美术对接需求风格。
bullets.en: Wrote design requirement documents, connected the ComfyUI workflow and MBTI calculation to engineering, and aligned the requested visual direction with art.
